items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had met Pete at the New School. He was in one of my ensembles there, and I just kinda wanted to, to show him off.

ctx.x: Yeah. Great players. And Pete Bernstein was… (laughs) You know, he was three years old or something. I just… I had met Pete at the New School. He was in one of my ensembles there, and I just kinda wanted to, to show him off. So he, he was there. Then my…
What did you hear as a guitarist of your style and history… what do you hear in Mick Goodrick and Scofield? What is it that turns you on?
